items.title_zh: 面向运动想象EEG解码的自监督预训练项目
items.title_en: Self-Supervised Pretraining for Motor Imagery EEG BCI
bullets_zh: BurhanxGodhra的GitHub项目（发布于2026-09-15）实现了面向被试无关运动想象EEG解码的自监督对比预训练。
该项目将黎曼几何与少样本校准融合，并与经典基线进行基准测试，附带两个Streamlit应用。
它有助于降低非侵入式BCI运动想象系统的个体校准负担，适合高级用户参考。
bullets_en: GitHub project by BurhanxGodhra (published 2026-09-15) implements self-supervised contrastive pretraining for subject-independent motor imagery EEG decoding.
It fuses Riemannian geometry with few-shot calibration and benchmarks against a classical baseline, adding two Streamlit apps.
Useful as an advanced non-invasive BCI resource for reducing per-subject calibration burden in EEG motor imagery systems.
items.brief: 面向运动想象EEG的自监督预训练项目，支持少样本校准与基准测试。
items.brief_en: Self-supervised EEG motor imagery BCI project for few-shot calibration and benchmarking.
items.raw_excerpt: Self-supervised contrastive pretraining for subject-independent motor imagery EEG decoding — fused with Riemannian geometry for few-shot calibration, benchmarked against a classical baseline, with two working Streamlit apps.

items.title_zh: 面向ERP-BCI不平衡解码的正交分解表示增强项目
items.title_en: Orthogonal Decomposition Representation Augmentation for ERP-BCI
bullets_zh: MKANEON/ODRA的GitHub项目（发布于2026-09-15）提出了面向不平衡ERP-BCI解码的正交分解表示增强方法。
该方法通过正交分解增强特征表示，以应对事件相关电位BCI数据中的类别不平衡问题。
它适用于非侵入式EEG BCI校准与鲁棒性提升，尤其适合各类训练样本分布不均的场景。
bullets_en: GitHub project MKANEON/ODRA (published 2026-09-15) presents orthogonal decomposition-based representation augmentation for imbalanced ERP-BCI decoding.
The method targets class imbalance in event-related potential BCI data by augmenting feature representations through orthogonal decomposition.
It is relevant to non-invasive EEG BCI calibration and robustness when training samples are unevenly distributed across classes.

items.title_en: BCI Regulatory Intelligence: Legal Act Tracking Collector and UI
bullets_zh: GitHub项目tmai-tech/regintel于2026-09-15发布，是脑机接口监管情报采集器。
它追踪法律法案并提供界面，用于查看脑机接口相关监管信息。
其意义在于可帮助监测与非侵入式脑机接口产品相关的合规信号。
bullets_en: GitHub project tmai-tech/regintel was published on 2026-09-15 as a BCI regulatory intelligence collector.
It tracks legal acts and provides a UI for reviewing BCI-related regulatory information.
It matters because it can help monitor compliance signals relevant to non-invasive BCI products.
